user_input: It was my birthday yesterday. I stayed up till midnight hoping maybe someone from my project group or my lab partner would drop a text, but nothing. user_input: We had to form groups of four for our web development capstone project today. user_input: It's 9 PM and I've been staring at my DSA lab assignment for four hours. user_input: We had to form groups of four for our web development capstone project today. user_input: It is Friday night in the hostel and the silence in my room is suffocating. user_input: Everyone got into their friend groups during orientation week, but I was late to campus because of my compartment exam. sandhi_response: It is incredibly heavy to sit in a room full of laughter and feel like you are completely invisible behind your plate. Please know that your quiet presence there is not a failure on your part, and it is okay to take this transition one small, silent breath at a time.

user_input: It's Friday night and my entire wing is dead quiet because everyone went out to some cafe or birthday party in town.
